android-content|Badge.summary: A Plenix badge on Android is Material 3’s badge, kept native in behavior (anchored to the top end of an icon, mirrored for right-to-left, announced by TalkBack through the anchor’s description, font scaling) and styled with the Plenix tokens: a 6 dp status dot and a 16 dp count pill in the Plenix feedback colors, the pill with a 1 dp border a step darker than its fill and a bold DM Sans number in the Android eyebrow role. Material’s default is the error color with no border and a Roboto number; Plenix keeps Material’s structure and replaces the look.
